title: Ex-Bangladesh PM Hasina to return home despite 'threat of death'
paragraphs: Ex-Bangladesh PM Hasina to return home despite 'threat of death'
“No threat of death will keep me away from my own country,” says former Bangladesh prime minister Sheikh Hasina as she plans a December return.

NEW DELHI: Ousted Bangladesh prime minister Sheikh Hasina, sentenced to capital punishment after she was toppled in 2024, told AFP on Monday (Nov 16) she would return home in December despite "the threat of death".
